scope: New post-development diagnostic; not a formal holdout or an AR03 reproduction
intervention: Swap both physical property channels before rendering. Keep candidate footprints, geometry, background render seed and card fixed. Randomly permute candidate order identically within each original/swapped pair. No twin examples enter training or validation.
role_metadata_diagnostic: Privileged diagnostic using training mean risk by generator role and card; not asserted to be an actual input to the learned methods.
mean_field_no_rgb: Training mean spatial field pooled along each supplied candidate footprint, composed with public formula. No test RGB or truth.
primary: Paired scene regret: factorized_no_cf minus predicted_formula on the equally weighted original/swapped fresh_appearance set, averaged across the three fixed model seeds.
secondary: false-safe eligible counts and micro rate
paired both-decisions-correct probability on unique-optimum-changing cards
uncertainty: 10000 paired scene bootstrap resamples, preserving original/swapped pairs and averaging the three training seeds first; conditional on these three seeds. Also report every seed.
semantic_protocol: Legacy two-property mean-exposure union cost only; do not pool with three-property q95 C3 data.
checkpoint_policy: Export every newly trained visual checkpoint, exact prediction arrays, targets, candidate footprints, training history and source hashes. No best-seed selection.
stopping_rule: Run each listed seed once with the captured recipe. No tuning on fresh probes. Failures are retained; reruns require a separate documented execution reason.
